name: Southern Utah Fall Open 2018

venue.name: [Vista School](https://www.vistautah.com/)
venue.address: 585 E Center St, Ivins, UT 84738, USA
venue.details: Walk through the west doors and enter directly into the gymnasium.

information: Competitors must sign up and pay online to be considered fully registered. There will be no walk-in registration. The competitor limit is 70 so register while you can. Pizza will be included in the registration fee. Spectator pizza can be purchased at the door for a cost of $3 and includes two slices of pizza and a water. **Before registering, read over the information tab.**
